description: Capability for the Ideas companion window: the core set and ONE plugin right. It reaches serve through the app's own commands (engine_connect) and its socket, and must not inherit main's opener, dialog, updater, process or notification rights. Ideas phase 1 adds exactly what it uses: the opener's reveal, for Show in Finder (called only through app/src/onhost.ts). Not opener:default, which would also open URLs.
